_format: One entry per full fight, keyed by the lower-case boss name. Fields: phases (list, at least two; each target belongs to one fight only) and note (optional, short fact shown with the fight). Each phase: target (required; a bundled monster name exactly as in the monster data), label (optional; shown name, default the title-cased target), share (optional, default 1; fraction of the target's hitpoints dealt in this phase, a number or an a/b fraction; forms sharing one health bar split it, separate health bars use 1), count (optional, default 1; times the target is fought per kill), phase (optional; an EncounterPhase name applied to that target), styles (optional; the combat classes that may attack it, from melee, ranged and magic, e.g. ranged and magic for a target attacked from a distance; default any). Work in a phase = count x share x the target's hitpoints. hp (optional): the damage to deal per count in place of the target's hitpoints, either a number or a team formula {base, per, from, cap} = min(cap, base + per x max(0, party - from)), with party = the Party size setting (from defaults to 1; no cap when absent); share still multiplies it. split (optional, default false): the party shares this damage, so your work is divided by the party size (also right for adds that pick a random player, whose expected share is 1/party). Searching any phase target plans the whole fight. Pre-fight drains and landed specs carry to phases with share below 1 (one shared health bar, so the same NPC); a phase with share 1 is a separate or reborn target and is planned undrained. Planned special attacks are paid from one fight's energy walking the phases in the listed order (an estimate where forms alternate); a planned drain counts on its phase and the later-listed ones on the same health bar, and none is planned on a phase with count above 1. bar (optional): the name of the phase's health bar, for a fight with more than one shared health bar; by default every phase with share below 1 is on the fight's one shared bar and any other phase has its own.

zulrah.note: Forms by how often each appears over the four rotations (Wiki); the rotation may end in any form.

alchemical hydra.note: A phase change at each of 75%, 50% and 25% of its health (Wiki).

araxxor.note: Enrages at 25% (Wiki). One araxyte of each attacked kind per kill is an estimate; ruptura araxytes are lured to explode, not attacked.

kalphite queen.note: Each form has its own 255 HP (Wiki).

vet'ion.note: Two hellhounds in each form make him immune until they die; he is reborn enraged with full HP (Wiki).

phantom muspah.note: Shields below 127 of 850 HP; before that it switches form after about 100 damage in ranged form and 80 in melee (Wiki). The shield is drained with Smite, which isn't planned.

abyssal sire.note: Phase 1 is spent on the four respiratory systems while the Sire is disoriented. Phase 3 starts below 210 of 425 HP, its second stage below 140 (Wiki).

yama.note: A Judge at about 66% and 33%: it prays ranged and your last style, so melee and magic alternate and the Judge's HP is shared in a duo (Wiki). Void flares heal him unless killed: one fire and one shadow in each of phases 1 and 2, then two shadow waves of two in phase 3 (an estimate).

vorkath.note: A zombified spawn is summoned by each freeze special; two per kill is an estimate. The freeze holds you until it dies, so it is attacked from range (Wiki).

the nightmare.note: Her own HP falls only to the totems. Each of three phases: break her shield, then charge four totems (double magic damage). Shield 2,000 and totems 300 for teams up to 5, then +200 and +30 per extra player (Wiki; caps 19,600 and 2,640). Two husks in phase 1 and two parasites in phase 2 go for random players; sleepwalkers die to any damage and aren't planned.

phosani's nightmare.note: Of her 3,200 HP, three shields of 400 and 150 HP in the final phase are dealt (Wiki), planned as one phase; four totems are charged after each shield (double magic damage). Two husk specials and one parasite are an estimate; sleepwalkers die to any damage and aren't planned.

royal titans.note: Branda and Eldric each have their own health bar (Wiki).
